author: Kea gana

title: Pretty good app overall
body: Pretty good app overall. My only gripe is that I can’t see exactly which habits/tasks I completed on a particular day. It just provides a heat map, which is quite gimmicky. It would be cool to be able to click on a particular day and see which habits I completed on that day.
author: Emirhan Caner
